theorems.name: Submission.frt_weq_mul_hausdorff_le_of_upper_density
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclidean N)) (W A : Set (Euclidean N)) (t : ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen W → A ⊆ W → (∀ x ∈ A, t ≤ limsup (densityRatio n μ x) (𝓝[>] 0)) → t * μHE[n] A ≤ μ W
